stories.summary: President Trump says Colombia will accept deportees, ending a tariff standoff between the two countries. The report places the dispute within Trump’s early second-term focus on immigration, during which ICE made more than 900 arrests on Sunday.

links.headline: Trump Says Colombia Will Accept Deportees, Ending Tariff Standoff
links.excerpt: The president has made immigration an early priority to start second term, with ICE making more than 900 arrests Sunday.
